name: Zulfa Maharani
bio:
Zulfa Maharani Putri (born on December 10, 1999, in Jakarta) is an Indonesian actress and model. She completed her bachelor's degree in Communication Science at the Institute of Communication and Business LSPR.

Her acting career began with a role in the film Kau dan Aku Cinta Indonesia (2014) as Cahaya Larasati. She gained further recognition for her role as Rani in Dilan 1990 (2018) and its sequel, Dilan 1991 (2019). Additionally, she appeared in Bebas (2019) as the teenage version of Gina.

In 2022, Zulfa played Zahra in the horror film Qorin. Her portrayal of an ambitious female student garnered widespread attention.

Zulfa also starred in the film Pernikahan Arwah (2025) as Tasya. This horror film, which incorporates Chinese cultural elements, provided her with a new experience in exploring the culture.

Besides feature films, Zulfa has been actively involved in television series and TV movies, demonstrating her dedication to the Indonesian entertainment industry.
